subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should maintainers accept replacing Node fs.glob with the custom yielding walker for bootstrap-extra-files now that the patch preserves broad glob matches and keeps SDK surface unchanged?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and tested, but it changes a compatibility-sensitive bootstrap configuration path for existing workspaces, so maintainer ownership should confirm the tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept the yielding walker
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree the preserved match-set tests and real behavior proof are enough for the upgrade risk.

options.title: Require broader upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for one more exact-head proof against a representative existing bootstrap-extra-files config before merge.

options.title: Pause for a smaller patch
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want only async root reads or hook yields without replacing fs.glob yet.

recommendation.title: Accept the yielding walker
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree the preserved match-set tests and real behavior proof are enough for the upgrade risk.

likelyOwner.reason: His prior bootstrap read, helper, and internal-hook history is the strongest owner signal for this merge-risk call.
